question.text: In the extraction of Ca by electro reduction of molten $\mathrm{CaCl}_{2}$ some $\mathrm{CaF}_{2}$ is added to the electrolyte for the following reason:

options.text: To keep the electrolyte in liquid state at temperature lower than the m. p. of $\mathrm{CaCl}_{2}$
To effect the electrolysis at lower voltage

solution.text:
Hint: 
$\mathrm{CaF}_{2}$ decreases the melting point of $\mathrm{CaCl}_{2}$
